4504.source_text: [Auto] When you play this card, choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards or up to 2 cards in your opponent's hand. Your opponent places all of the chosen cards in the Drop Area.

4506.source_text: [activate: main] look at up to 7 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 2 red ≪frieza's army≫ cards with energy costs of 4 or more among them and add them to your hand, then shuffle your deck.

4507.source_text: [Activate: Battle] If your Leader Card is green: Choose up to 1 of your Leader Cards or Battle Cards and it gets +15000 power for the duration of the battle.
[Auto] If all of your energy is green: When you activate this card, choose 1 card in your opponent's hand and place it in their Drop Area.

4508.source_text: [Permanent] This card gains «Desire» in all areas.

[Activate: Main] If your Leader Card is a blue «Shenron» card: Choose 1 blue «Saiyan» card in your Drop Area with 15000 or less power and an energy cost of 2 or less and play it. If you do, place the top card of your deck under the card you played with this skill.

4512.source_text: [activate: main]  you may choose 1 of your green <hirudegarn> cards and ko it. if you do, draw 1 card

handler_params.required_characters: It Gets 10000 Power For The Battle,Then You May Send 2 30000 Power To Your Warp. If You Do,Choose Up To 1 Of Your Leader
handler_params.requires_leader: if your leader card is a <dark broly> card

4513.source_text: [activate: battle] if your leader card is a <dark broly> card: choose up to 1 of your cards, it gets +10000 power for the battle, then you may send 2 black battle cards with 30000 power from your drop area to your warp. if you do, choose up to 1 of your leader cards and it gets +5000 power for the turn.

4514.source_text: [blocker] (when one of your other cards is attacked, you may switch this card to rest mode and change the target of the attack to this card)
[double strike] (this card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking)

4515.source_text: [Activate: Main] If your opponent has 5 or more energy: Your opponent can't play Battle Cards using Leader Card skills until the end of their next turn.

4516.source_text: [Counter: Battle Card Attack] If your Leader Card is a red «Earthling»-only card: Negate the attack, then if you have a red «Earthling» card in play, place this card on top of the attacking card. At the end of your next turn, place this card-and only this card-in its owner's Drop Area. (While this card is on top of another card, the card underneath it is not treated as a Battle Card and can't activate any of its skills.)

4517.source_text: [Permanent] This card gains «Desire» in all areas.
[Activate: Main] Choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards, and switch them to Rest Mode.

4518.source_text: [Activate: Main] Choose 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and send it to its owner's Warp, then choose 1 of your Battle Cards and send it to its owner's Warp.
